m: Brown the mince hard in a big pan. Add the diced onion and cook 5 minutes, then the garlic and all the spices for 1 minute.
Stir in the tomato paste, crushed tomatoes and drained beans. Simmer 10 minutes until thick and season well.
Guacamole: mash the avocado with lime juice, salt and some chopped coriander. Salsa: chopped tomatoes, red onion, coriander and lime.
Oven to 200°C. Spread the corn chips on trays, spoon over the beef and cover with cheese.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbling.
Top with guac, salsa, sour cream and jalapeños and get it on the table fast.
l: Pack the beef with rice instead of chips (burrito bowl style), toppings on the side.
g: Plain corn chips are usually gluten free, but check the bag. Check the spices too.
